About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Cisco Solutions Executive is responsible for the acquisition of net new Cisco business within a given territory. They will proactively leverage internal data, alongside Cisco and partner insights, to identify and generate sales opportunities and meetings with prospects through outreach activities and account profiling. This role serves as a customer-facing subject matter expert to build pipeline and close Cisco-focused deals across the Cisco portfolio.

Role Description

  • Generate, identify, and drive pipeline by understanding customer business and technology needs and positioning Cisco solutions and services to deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Drive Cisco growth by profiling, qualifying, and prospecting into Public Sector whitespace and existing customer expansion opportunities.

  • Execute against new Cisco logo and expansion KPI’s with strong pipeline inspection and opportunity management discipline.

  • Serve as a customer-facing subject matter expert on Cisco technologies, architectures, and lifecycle services to help customers select, deploy, adopt, and optimize Cisco solutions.

  • Strategically partner with sales leadership, account executives, and Cisco field teams to execute territory and account acquisition strategies.

  • Maintain deep working knowledge of Cisco product roadmaps, licensing models, and architectural use cases across networking, security, collaboration, data center, and cloud.

  • Present the company’s Cisco value proposition at customer briefings, partner events, and industry forums.

  • Develop, test, refine, and scale repeatable Cisco-focused sales motions and go-to-market strategies.

  • Assist in training Public Sector Sales teams on Cisco offerings and solution positioning.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Adaptability: Can adjust to changes in the work environment, manage multiple tasks, and effectively handle uncertainty.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.

  • Negotiation: Can identify opportunities for compromise, propose solutions, and take action to influence outcomes without explicit instructions.

  • Business Development: Can identify potential business opportunities, propose strategies for growth, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Relationship Building: Can identify opportunities for collaboration, propose strategies for effective communication, and build relationships without explicit instructions.

  • Listening: Can recognize underlying messages and non-verbal cues in communication, responding appropriately to both explicit and implicit information.

  • Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.

  • Presenting: Can prepare and deliver presentations, addressing key points and responding to questions with clarity.

Skill Level Requirements

  • The ability to effectively utilize applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook to enhance productivity and perform various tasks efficiently - Intermediate

  • Proficiency in utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software to manage and analyze customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle, improving customer service, retention, and sales growth - Intermediate

Other Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant work experience required.

  • Familiarity with Cisco sales tools, quoting, and partner engagement processes.

  • Experience within Public Sector sales

  • 5+ years of experience in an Inside Sales or Outside Sales role.

  • 5+ years of experience selling Cisco solutions or working in a Cisco-focused partner environment.

  • Ability to travel approximately 20%.

Preferred:

  • Experience with a manufacturer or VAR, and experience in K-12, State & Local Government, or Higher Education strongly preferred; candidates with related experience in a subset of these areas will also be considered.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $110,000 - $175,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Position Title: Sr. Requirements Engineer

Department: Engineering

Entity: e-Storage

Location: US

Reports To: Technical Requirements Manager, eStorage

Position Summary:

We are looking for a motivated Senior Requirements Engineer to specialize in EMS controls and Power Conversion Systems for utility-scale battery energy storage systems. The candidate will develop technical requirements aligned with business goals and objectives.

As part of the engineering team, the Sr. Requirements Engineer will create control system and power conversion system specifications that meet all project requirements, guide control system technologies, and implement processes for global utility-scale energy storage solutions. Familiarity with power systems, utility scale inverters, utility generation, protection and transmission, modern industrial networks, and utility communication protocols is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop Technical Requirements: Create and maintain technical requirements for battery energy storage control systems and Power Conversion Systems (PCS) in line with company goals and industry standards.
  • Cyber security: Develop a set of security requirements and templates.
  • Review Project-Specific Requirements: Carefully review and ensure project-specific requirements for control systems and Power Conversion Systems are met.
  • Negotiate and Develop Requirements Management: Develop comprehensive requirements management strategies tailored to specific client needs and industry requirements.
  • Track Applicable Standards: Monitor applicable standards and analyze their implications on our products, communicating these to the R&D, commercial, and engineering teams.
  • Certification Testing Solutions: Assist in finding solutions to challenges related to certification testing.
  • Examine Test Samples: Read and understand schematics, wiring diagrams, and operational instructions to examine test samples.
  • Conduct Risk Assessments: Identify potential compliance risks and vulnerabilities within our products, developing strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and standards.
  • Regular Reporting: Report regularly to the business team and relevant stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  • Utilize and maintain AI tools for developing technical requirements.
  • Utilize and maintain version control tools to make sure the requirements are traceable, auditable, and change-managed throughout the lifecycle.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in the design and implementation of global compliance standards for products such as SCADA and EMS, batteries, electrical systems, HVAC, inverters, or other industrial products.
  • Knowledge of UL & IEC requirements. Knowledge of NERC-CIP cyber security requirements.
  • Experience with regional and global regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of battery-related standards such as IEC62619, UL1973, IEC62933-5-1/-2, UL9540, UL9540A, NFPA855, ISO-27019​
  • Proven success in working independently, handling multiple tasks, and determining priorities in a team environment, balanced by an ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines or functional groups.
  • Deep understanding of battery systems.
  • Participation in compliance or standard-related councils is a plus.

Key Competencies:

  • Experience with technical requirements drafting
  • Strong technical and analytical abilities
  • Results-driven, with a focus on execution
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.

  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.

  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.

  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.

  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.

  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.

  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.

  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

  • Strong analytical skills, including category, consumer insights, financial reporting and P&L management.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:

  • Understanding of Club and Natural Channel, including sales and merchandising techniques.

raw.description:
About RYZE:

The Role:

The Role

RYZE is entering national retail, and the gap between a great product getting listed and a great product getting sold is shopper marketing. We can earn distribution. What happens at the shelf and in the digital aisle after that is what this role owns.

The Director of Retail and Shopper Marketing is how RYZE wins on shelf and in the moments right before the purchase. You build the programs that convert awareness into trial, and trial into loyalty. You make RYZE feel like the obvious choice in the aisle, not a new product that requires explanation.

You understand that shopper marketing at an emerging brand is fundamentally different from shopper marketing at a major CPG company. You do not have a hundred-year brand trust story. You do not have massive co-op budgets. You win through sharper strategy, smarter retailer integration, and a brand experience at the point of purchase that actually resonates. This role sits at the intersection of brand, sales, and retail execution. You are the architect of how RYZE shows up at retail: on shelf, in the digital aisle, and in every customer-specific program we build.

What You’ll Do

Shopper Marketing Strategy

You develop the annual shopper marketing strategy and calendar: by channel, by customer, by season. You decide how to allocate trade and shopper dollars to maximize trial, drive repeat, and build loyalty. You set the standard for what good looks like for RYZE at retail, and you enforce it across every touchpoint.

Retailer Media & Digital Shopper Programs

You are fluent in retailer media networks: Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, Kroger Precision Marketing, Instacart Ads, and others. You build programs that connect brand investment to in-store execution and deliver measurable ROAS. You do not treat retailer media as a standalone tactic; you wire it to the full shopper journey, from search to shelf.

In-Store Execution & Visual Merchandising

You own the tools that build presence on shelf: displays, POS, shippers, secondary placements, and branded fixtures. You ensure RYZE shows up in-store with the same clarity and conviction it has online. You have a high bar for what the RYZE shelf experience should feel like, and you hold it.

Customer-Specific Programs

You build tailored programs for key retail partners that integrate RYZE's brand priorities with their retailer initiatives. You know how to speak to buyers, work within their planning timelines, and build programs that retailers want, not just tolerate. You understand that the best shopper marketing is a genuine partnership, not a media buy.

Trade Strategy & Budget Management

You manage the shopper marketing budget with discipline. You know the difference between trade spending that builds brand equity and trade spending that only buys temporary velocity. You build measurement frameworks, track ROI across vehicles, and make hard calls about where to invest and where to pull back.

Team & Agency Management

You manage a small but growing team and external agency partners. You set a high standard for execution quality, build a culture of accountability and ownership, and develop the people around you.

What We’re Looking For

  • You have 8+ years of progressive experience in Shopper Marketing, Retail Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Customer Marketing.

  • Someone who has developed and executed shopper marketing programs that drove retail growth, strengthened retailer partnerships, and delivered measurable business results.

  • You have experience creating customer-specific programs, supporting line reviews, and building integrated shopper marketing strategies across retail channels. You know how to translate consumer and shopper insights into programs that drive trial, velocity, and loyalty.

  • You are comfortable using metrics such as ROAS, velocity, TPR performance, and loyalty data to evaluate performance and make informed recommendations. You use data to identify opportunities, improve programs, and support better business decisions.

Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.

We’re a performance marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.

We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution. We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow.

We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-time Business Development Manager who can turn great work into consistent growth.

You’ll be the first point of contact for brands ready to scale. Your role is to open doors, build relationships, and bring new clients into the Acceler8 fold across North America. This is a sales-driven role that blends persistence with insight. You’ll prospect, pitch, and follow up with potential clients who could benefit from what we do best: performance marketing that actually performs. You’ll work closely with leadership to sharpen our story, identify high-potential accounts, and help drive the next wave of growth for Acceler8.

As a Business Development Manager, you will:

  • Develop and manage a pipeline of qualified leads through research, outreach, and relationship building
  • Conduct cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, and calls) to connect with decision-makers at marketing-led, performance-driven brands
  • Lead discovery conversations, identify client needs, and position Acceler8 as the right growth partner
  • Create and present tailored proposals that communicate our value clearly and confidently
  • Collaborate with leadership on outreach strategy, pricing models, and proposal materials
  • Maintain accurate tracking and reporting of pipeline progress, outreach activity, and conversion rates
  • Represent Acceler8 at industry events and networking opportunities to strengthen our market presence

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5-10 years of experience in business development or sales, with at least 3 years in media, advertising, or performance marketing agencies
  • Know how to sell marketing services - not just by the numbers, but by understanding how agencies deliver results
  • Can comfortably talk about paid media, performance strategy, creative testing, and what sets great campaigns apart
  • Have a builder’s mindset and like being hands-on, from cold outreach to closing

  • Live in Canada (we’re a remote-first team)

Why Acceler8 Labs?

We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration. Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact.

Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship.

We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

  • Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
  • Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work
  • The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you

If you’re ready to lead a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & TeamAs part of the team, you will be working with a team of smart, friendly, and dedicated Engineers, Product Managers and Designers determined to deliver some of the best apps the market has to offer. We are looking for an Incident Commander to join our site reliability team, to work cross-functionally across engineering, and be the front line for incidents and working with Release Engineering to help prevent new events.

This is a position responsible for all incidents across various organizations within the company, both online and physical, which includes P1, P2, P3 and P4. Classifying and documenting all incidents and carrying out support, assisting and driving all incidents, regarding investigation, hierarchical and technical escalation, diagnosis and recovery and root cause analysis. Additionally driving improvements to our service delivery and release processes based on disruption reports.

About the Work

• Drive and enhance collaboration with other Incident Commanders, Customer Support, Application and Engineering teams - cross-functional teams to lead real-time incident management.
• Provides Leadership for developing Practices, Frameworks, Process Flows, Templates and Process Guides
• Continuously improve and enhance the internal framework, methodology, processes, and tools
• Developing and maintaining key practical capabilities
• Collaborating with SRE Teams and Infrastructure teams to identify requirements and gaps resulting in downtime or blindspots.
• Recommends innovative solutions that enable the organization to deliver on its objectives and goals.
• Promote opportunities for Continuous Service Improvements
• Manage and update Root Cause Analysis documentation.
• Lead SRE communications to stakeholders via E-mail, Slack, & Teams in timely manner
• Lead initiatives to promote JIRA Release Ticket management, quality and alignment with Incident management communication supporting SLAs

• Other duties as required.

About You

• Experience in a similar role or incident management role.
• Experience and understanding of Containerization (Docker & Kubernetes preferred)
• Automation: Understanding of configuration management and infrastructure as code tools. Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.
• Experience with a programming language.
• Comfortable within Linux environments and needs.
• Experience working with AWS, GCP, and on-premises environments.
• Ability to work independently and learn quickly with little supervision.
• Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
• Willingness to drop everything and take on an ad-hoc task.
• You’re the type of individual who is tech-savvy and passionate about learning new technologies and tools.
• Out-going, and able to keep a conversation going naturally to extract needed information
• A degree in computer science, engineering, and/or similar experience.
• Nice to have: Postgres, MySQL, Elastic Search, Kafka, Redis, Terragrunt, Prometheus, Python, Talos Linux

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Fun, relaxed work environment.
  • Education and conference reimbursements.
  • Parental leave top up.
  • Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others.

Location Designation: Fully Remote

Role Overview:

Responsible for managing and driving the new business processes for a successful implementation of New York Life Group Benefit Solutions (GBS) products for new and existing GBS clients. Directs and coordinates all aspects of the implementation process for clients. Delivers upon the service moments that matter by ensuring clear and concise communication, guiding the client and broker throughout the implementation. Ultimately, fulfills the promises we make to the client in the sales process: to build their employee benefits program through transparency, communication, trusted consultation, product expertise, and service excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Primarily focuses on implementing complex, multiple product policy types (all product types of LAD, VB, Absence or combination) for specialty clients with more than 5,000 lives.
  • Responsible for the end-to-end management of the implementation process and timeliness of key deliverables within the onboarding experience including enrollment readiness, data exchange, contract delivery, and premium administration actions from point of sale through transition to ongoing account management. Is the primary contact for all parties throughout the implementation.
  • Interacts directly with Clients, Sales, Broker and Account Management to guide and collect plan design and administrative decisions. Works collaboratively with several business partners including, but not limited to: Data Exchange, Premium Administration, Enrollment, Contracts, Configuration, and Claims. Accountable for the timely execution of tasks and deliverables on behalf of the NYL team associated with implementation. Ensures accurate documents are delivered to the customer.
  • Identifies and resolves issues throughout the implementation process. Monitors and communicates project status if client is at risk of meeting milestone dates, deliverables, or encounters barriers that moderately or significantly impacts the successful execution of services and experience. raw.description:
Summary

The Director, Clinical Data Management is responsible for the oversight of data management activities in support of Alnylam studies across all stages of clinical drug development. This position reports to the head of the Clinical Data & Insights group.

Responsibilities:

  • Direct and grow internal data management expertise area, including management of direct reports;
  • Direct and establish standards for data management CRO outsourcing strategy and deliverables, including the CRO selection process and the governance of CRO performance;
  • Oversee the successful execution of all data management activities in support of Alnylam clinical studies in partnership with CROs, including eCRF development, database build, data collection, data coding, cleaning, database lock and archiving;
  • Supervise the execution of cross-functional, internal data review plans by direct reports across all Alnylam clinical studies;
  • Partner with internal and external partners, including Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, Medical, Quality Assurance, Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics, Bioanalytical, Safety & Risk Management (SRM) and Regulatory Affairs; CROs, central and local laboratories, and other vendors;
  • Lead development and implementation of data collection standards, consistent with industry best practice;
  • Lead data management contributions to the development of clinical protocols, clinical study reports and other regulatory documents, e.g. DSURs, Briefing Documents, etc.
  • Oversee development of department workflows, and infrastructure strategy and implementation, such as preferred provider initiatives, SOPs, and templates;
  • Collaborate with Statistical Programming and external vendors to ensure compliance of SDTM clinical datasets, consistent with CDISC standards;
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations and Quality Assurance to certify the integrity and traceability of all clinical data sources, compliant with 21 CFR Part 11 standards;
  • Direct Data Management GCP inspection readiness efforts; function as a leader for Data Management in GCP inspections;
  • Represent Data Management at internal cross-functional meetings and external vendor leadership meetings;
  • Demonstrate clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including, Commitment to People, Fiercely Innovative, Purposeful Urgency, Open Culture and Passion for Excellence.

Requirements

  • BS/BA in scientific discipline, MS or equivalent preferred, with at least 15 years of clinical data management experience in a pharmaceutical/biologics/biotechnology company, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity;
  • Extensive experience managing global studies utilizing an outsourced CDM model from start-up through close-out;
  • Extensive experience managing direct reports and providing performance reviews and career development guidance;
  • Understanding of ICH GCP as well as general knowledge of industry practices and standards;
  • Knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements and expectations for clinical data systems including 21 CFR Part 11;
  • Expert knowledge of eClinical processes, efficient design/build of an EDC data management system and other Clinical Trial data/Data Management Systems;
  • Expert knowledge and understanding of regulations and industry-adopted data standards, such as CDISC-SDTM and CDASH;
  • Experience using standardized medical terminology, including MedDRA and WHODrug;
  • Experience working with Medidata Rave EDC systems;
  • Experience working with elluminate or other data visualization systems a plus
  • Experience working with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) familiar with MS Project;
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills;
  • Highly motivated and flexible, with excellent organizational skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

U.S. Pay Range

$197,200.00 - $266,800.00

The pay range reflects the full-time base salary range we expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations within our hybrid AI + human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide bot engineering expertise, conversational design judgment, and quality control to ensure bots are reliable, useful, and ready for real users. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Evaluate AI-generated bot code and refactor it for correctness, reliability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and refine AI-assisted output into stable, user-friendly experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

raw.description:
📍 Remote | Equity-Only | Build the Future of Hiring at Luupli

About Luupli
Luupli is not your average social media platform. We’re creator-first, equity-focused, and building a safer, smarter social experience from the ground up. Currently in beta, we’re on a mission to put creativity, community, and fairness back at the heart of online connection. Think next-gen product meets real-world impact.

We’re a small, mighty, and global team and we’re growing.

🎯 The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Lead to help us scale our team from early hires to core engine. If you love sourcing amazing people, designing seamless candidate journeys, and building talent systems from scratch, this is your moment.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll own:

  • Sourcing and attracting top talent across technical and non-technical roles

  • Managing the recruitment lifecycle from outreach to offer

  • Building foundational hiring processes, systems, and templates

  • Supporting onboarding, culture alignment, and early retention

You’ll work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define how recruitment works at Luupli, from day one through day 90.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

  • Lead sourcing efforts across engineering, product, design, and growth roles

  • Build diverse, high-quality talent pipelines using creative outreach methods

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment funnel: sourcing, screening, coordination, feedback, and offers

  • Create job descriptions, scorecards, interview plans, and templates

  • Partner with hiring managers and founders to understand talent needs and timelines

  • Set up and maintain light-weight ATS or candidate tracking systems

  • Improve candidate experience and ensure timely, respectful communication throughout

  • Support pre-boarding and onboarding processes (checklists, intros, first week plans)

  • Report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and hiring success metrics

🌱 You Might Be...

  • A senior recruiter or sourcing specialist ready to take the lead

  • Someone who’s worked in an agency or startup environment and wants more ownership

  • Obsessed with candidate experience and creative sourcing

  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats (yes, you might draft a JD one day and onboard someone the next)

  • A system-builder who loves creating structure out of chaos

  • Eager to grow into a future Head of Talent role as the company scales

🔎 Requirements

  • 3+ years experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or sourcing

  • Proven experience building candidate pipelines for tech and/or creative roles

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple roles at once

  • Clear, engaging communication, written and verbal

  • Experience setting up or managing hiring systems or ATS tools

  • Comfortable working remotely and independently

  • Passion for startups, social tech, or the future of work

💸 Compensation

This is an equity-only role at this stage. There is no salary or cash compensation pre-funding. You’ll receive meaningful equity in Luupli in recognition of your contribution. Once we secure funding, equity hires will be considered first for full-time paid roles.

🌀 Why Join Luupli?

We're not just building a company, we’re rewriting the script for what social media can be.

At Luupli, we believe creators deserve better. Communities deserve safety. And the internet deserves more equity, empathy, and innovation. That’s why we’re building a platform from the ground up, with ethics, creativity, and fairness baked into the code.

This role is your chance to do more than hire great people, you’ll be shaping how an entire generation of Luupers join us. From the words in our job posts to the way someone feels on day one, you'll define the journey.

If you’ve ever wanted to:

  • Be trusted to build something meaningful from scratch

  • See your ideas implemented in real time

  • Work alongside founders, not under layers of management

  • Create impact beyond a KPI, in people’s careers, communities, and lives

  • Earn not just a salary someday, but a stake in something that matters

Then Luupli is for you.

We’re still early, but that’s the opportunity. This isn’t a polished machine. It’s the engine room of a rocket ship. And you get to help fuel the launch.

To Apply

Please use the link to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

🚫 Notice to Recruitment Agencies

Luupli does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any CVs received without prior written agreement will be considered the property of Luupli, and no fees will be payable.

raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Analytics(Senior Web Analytics Developer)

LeadVenture has brought together the premier website providers in the powersports, marine, RV, used auto, and a variety of other industries. Given this breadth of coverage, we are in a unique position to learn more about the consumer’s journey than most other players in our space, and effective data collection is key to fueling those downstream insights.

LeadVenture is looking for a Digital/Web Analyst Specialist to build and maintain a state-of-art digital analytics program, to provide digital analytics insights across multiple web platforms and thousands of sites. This individual will play an essential role in the organization by providing effective insights to understand the customer journey and how to optimize websites for customer success. This person will also oversee the data collection with various LeadVenture's digital intelligence systems and be the steward of data transformation and third-party integration with a Tag Management System. This will include working together with the Analytics Team Lead and Product Owner, directly with LeadVenture’s data lake engineers and stakeholders across the organization, including Marketing, Operations, Sales, IT, and more.

The successful candidate must have excellent oral and written communication skills, good business sense, and a strong passion for analytics. This candidate will think creatively and strategically and must understand how to tie digital website information directly to business insights and third-party applications. The candidate must be comfortable solving ambiguously defined problems, working with cross-functional team members, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve digital analytics.

Here is more of what you’ll get to do:

  • Work as an active participant on a full-time remote agile team
  • Become a go-to SME regarding tracking and analytics tooling
  • Design, build, test, monitor, and provide quality assurance of our Web data layer and web tags/pixels
  • Work closely with web developers, data engineers, and IT to ensure seamless tracking implementation, data collection, and multichannel data integration. Candidate must understand web analytics, content management, and data collection
  • Analyze business requirements. Clearly articulate the 'why' in addition to the 'what' while educating business stakeholders on digital analytics
  • Mapping core/enterprise tracking to third-party agencies
  • Manage troubleshooting to identify missing or misconfigured tagging needed for reporting and analysis
  • Maintain our Tag Management platform, releases, and enhancements needed to support business processes and goals
  • Provide motivation, collaboration, and guidance to the development team to build according to your design.
  • Build relationships with the main stakeholders: directors, internal leadership team, and external customers to ensure that your designed system architecture meets everyone's expectations

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 4+ years of JavaScript, HTML, CSS Experience (Websites and SPAs)
  • 3+ years of experience with digital analytics and tool administration systems (Google Analytics, Piwik, etc)
  • 3+ years of experience utilizing a Tag Management Platform (Google Tag Manager, Adobe DTM, Tealium, etc)
  • Experience with data layer concepts, data modeling & governance, digital analytics, implementation, and event handling methods via the DOM event model
  • Experience working with jQuery, Regular Expressions, HTML CSS selectors
  • Excellent browser debugging skills with debugging tool experience (Websites and SPAs)
  • Basic familiarity with digital marketing services, including SEO, SEM, and Email Marketing
  • Strong data interpretation and communications skills; proven ability to summarize and present
  • complex findings clearly and concisely to various technical and management levels
  • Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities, combined with an internal drive to stay on top of emerging industry trends
  • A natural tendency to set goals, demonstrate a ‘go-getter’ attitude, and take initiative with little oversight
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Ability to manage time, priorities, and multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Familiarity with JS Frameworks
  • Knowledge of Software Development LifeCycle (SDLC) like Agile
  • Familiarity with ETL and data modeling, specifically in AWS Data Lake environment preferred
  • Familiarity in data visualization tools including BI tools like PowerBI, Tableau, or Amazon Quicksight

Does this position sound like something you would enjoy and be successful at, but you’re not sure you have the exact qualifications to be considered? While our job descriptions are an outline for the type of candidate we’re looking for, it is not a checklist. We encourage you to apply!

This role is not open to candidates located in Colorado, Connecticut, California, Maryland, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, or Washington.

Who we are:

LeadVenture is the market-leading SaaS provider of digital retailing, eCommerce, digital marketing and eCatalog solutions for dealerships across 12 industry verticals including powersports, marine, RV, pre-owned auto, agriculture and more. Our family of brands includes Dealer Spike, Dealer Car Search, Frazer, Net Driven, Direct Communications, Inc. (DCi), Powersports Support, Level 5, PSM Marketing, Monroney Labels, and Interact RV. We are an international company with offices located in the United States, Mexico (Juniper Data Center), Belize (Dealer Spike Belize), India and The Netherlands. Together, we are LeadVenture.

LeadVenture provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, LeadVenture complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

LeadVenture expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of LeadVenture employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

We are looking for aPre-Sales Insights AnalystatEverHealth.EverHealth is simplifying the business of healthcare through simplified, user-centric software which streamlines the daily operations of healthcare practices. The right software can be critical to the health of a practice, and that’s why we’ve created an integrated ecosystem of intuitive, easy to use products that work with how providers run and grow their business. 

The Pre-Sales Insights Analyst is a key member of EverHealth's Revenue Analytics & Insights team, responsible for owning analytics across the pre-sales funnel from lead through closed-won. Reporting to the Revenue Analytics & Insights Manager, this role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to improve funnel performance, pipeline quality, and go-to-market decision-making.

Supporting four EverHealth product lines (DrChrono, CMD, Updox, and iSalus), the analyst will build scalable reporting and insights around funnel conversion, ICP segmentation, win/loss analysis, and pipeline health. This role transforms fragmented sales data into actionable insights that help leadership identify the best customer segments, improve conversion rates, increase forecast accuracy, and optimize GTM strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Own the analytical view of the pre-sale funnel from lead through closed-won.

  • Build and maintain funnel conversion reporting (Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Closed-Won).

  • Identify conversion gaps by product, segment, channel, and rep cohort.

  • Develop and maintain pipeline quality scoring based on fit, engagement, deal age, and stage velocity.

  • Analyze pipeline velocity and identify stall points.

  • Measure inbound and outbound lead quality by source, channel, and campaign.

  • Analyze SDR conversion rates and identify top-performer patterns.

  • Analyze AE performance, pipeline coverage, velocity, and closed-won rates.

  • Perform closed-lost analysis by stage, reason, segment, and competitor.

  • Build and maintain the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) framework.

  • Support ICP scoring models and refine lead scoring criteria.

  • Analyze segment performance, win rates, ACV, sales cycle, CAC, and time-to-value.

  • Build cohort analysis across products, segments, channels, and acquisition periods.

  • Support TAM and addressable market analysis using enrichment data.

  • Track ICP deviations and identify off-ICP win/loss trends.

  • Own the win/loss analysis program, including methodology, reporting, and competitive intelligence.

  • Produce recurring win/loss reports and actionable insights for Sales and Product leadership.

  • Support GTM planning with funnel benchmarks, quota attainment, capacity modeling, and productivity analysis.

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to accelerate analytics, reporting, and build reusable prompt libraries.

  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards for funnel, pipeline quality, quota attainment, and self-service analytics.

Skills and Experienceneeded for success in this role:

  • 2+ years in Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, or GTM Analytics with ownership of recurring reporting and analytical deliverables.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting and dashboard experience with knowledge of the SFDC data model and data quality management.

  • Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, formulas, data modeling).

  • Experience building funnel, conversion, and pipeline analytics, including stage conversion and drop-off analysis.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into actionable insights.

  • Comfortable working with imperfect data and driving continuous improvements.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting insights to business leaders.

  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve analytics and reporting workflows.

Preferred

  • Experience with ICP analysis, pipeline quality scoring, or win/loss analysis.

  • Knowledge of B2B SaaS metrics including MQL, SQL, ACV, CAC, pipeline coverage, and sales cycle analytics.

  • Healthcare or HealthTech experience.

  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Metabase.

  • SQL proficiency for self-service analysis.

  • Experience with CRM enrichment or sales intelligence tools (Gong, 6sense, Bombora, ZoomInfo, etc.).

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-assisted analytics, including AI agents or workflow automation.

Where:
TheEverCommerceteam is distributed globally, with teams inthe U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in theUnited States - ifyou’reclose to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or toother office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks(JUST U.S.):

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid

  • Continued investment in your professional development

  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.

  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting

  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target base compensation for this positionis $85,000 to $100,000USD yearin mostUS locations. Final offer amounts aredeterminedby multiple factors including location,local market variances, andcandidate experience andexpertise,and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations within our hybrid AI + human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide bot engineering expertise, conversational design judgment, and quality control to ensure bots are reliable, useful, and ready for real users. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Evaluate AI-generated bot code and refactor it for correctness, reliability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and refine AI-assisted output into stable, user-friendly experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

The Fresh Success program brings federal dollars to California to help students and other low-income community members gain the skills and experience they need to become more employable. The FoundationCCC supports E&T providers with tools, templates, training, and ongoing technical assistance to facilitate the start-up process, ease the burden of federal requirements, and ensure program success.

The Specialist is responsible for onboarding, monitoring, and supporting the ongoing success of Fresh Success providers, including community colleges, adult schools, and non-profit community-based organizations.

  • Strengthens the success of Fresh Success providers (community colleges, adult schools, and community-based organizations) through co-facilitation of onboarding trainings, webinars, and annual in-person convenings, and the provision of ongoing technical assistance for assigned providers.

  • Reviews quarterly invoices and data submissions from assigned Fresh Success providers, including reviewing costs for allowability, ensuring appropriate documentation, and ensuring a high level of data accuracy.

  • Performs program reviews and monitoring of assigned Fresh Success providers to ensure compliance with state CalFresh and federal SNAP Employment & Training guidelines and other relevant policies, provide technical assistance, and learn about challenges and promising practices.

  • Reviews and analyzes reports, data, and supporting documents and prepares recommendations for action.

  • Supports the design, logistics, and execution of webinars, conference presentations, and meetings to recruit new partners.

Attributes for Success

  • Strong project management skills, including attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks and execute responsibilities independently and on time

  • Proven ability to manage clients by influence and drives timely completion of client deliverables
  • Ability to learn and clearly communicate complex program requirements

  • We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better

  • Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions of individuals in California

  • FoundationCCC blends the impact of a non-profit, the culture of an entrepreneurial start-up, and the scale of a state agency

  • Team members are hired for theirexpertise in niche areas across our areas of impact and higher education overall, and for their knowledge of business, philanthropy, technology, communications, and more

  • We arecommitted to professional developmentwith anemphasis on shared leadership, to ensure growth for employees and the organization overall

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, and paid holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings

raw.description:
The Department of War Innovation Unit, in partnership with Warfighting Acquisition University, is seeking highly qualified and motivated mid-to-senior level contracting and agreements officers with proven technical contracting expertise coupled with an innovative mindset for the next Immersive Commercial Acquisition Program (ICAP) cohort. Applicants must be a permanent government civilian (GS-13/14 or NH-03/04 1102 series) or active component military contracting or agreements officer (O-4/O-5). DIU will start accepting applications on July 27, 2026 until October 9, 2026.

Each applicant must provide a resume, supervisor recommendation letter, and a letter of intent outlining why they are interested in the program. DIU will competitively select ICAP fellows for a 12 month rotation over a virtual collaboration/telework environment. DIU will notify selected candidates in November and begin the program in January 2027. ICAP Fellows will produce a capstone project that will serve as a training plan for their home organization based on experiences and lessons learned in the program.

For more information on the program please visit thelanding page!

Overview

The Senior Manager, Human Resources serves as a strategic partner to leaders across the organization, providing guidance and support on employee relations, performance management, workforce planning, employee engagement, and organizational effectiveness. This role partners closely with leaders to address complex people challenges, strengthen manager capability, and support business objectives. As the senior HR partner for assigned business units and corporate functions, the Senior Manager is expected to operate independently, influence decision-making, and help drive meaningful organizational change.

Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with leaders to understand business objectives and translate them into effective people strategies and actionable solutions.
  • Coach and advise leaders on employee relations matters, performance management, and organizational challenges.
  • Lead complex employee relations investigations and recommend appropriate resolutions while balancing business objectives, employee experience, and organizational risk.
  • Facilitate difficult conversations and provide guidance that promotes accountability, consistency, and positive business outcomes.
  • Partner with leaders to assess organizational challenges and provide guidance on workforce planning, organizational structure, talent assessment, succession planning, and other initiatives that improve team effectiveness and business performance.
  • Develop manager capability through coaching, mentoring, and practical guidance that strengthens leadership effectiveness and accountability.
  • Support organizational change initiatives, including team structure reviews, communication planning, and change readiness efforts.
  • Analyze workforce data, trends, and metrics to identify opportunities and provide recommendations to leaders.
  • Partner with leaders to improve employee engagement, retention, and overall team performance.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation to align hiring, retention, workforce planning, and talent strategies with business needs and organizational priorities.
  • Build strong partnerships with leaders across corporate and operational functions to ensure alignment between people strategies and business priorities.
  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Payroll, and People Operations to ensure alignment across people programs, talent initiatives, and workforce strategies while maintaining consistency across processes and employee experience.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.
  • Support the development and implementation of HR policies, programs, and initiatives that align with organizational priorities.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, HR best practices, and emerging employment practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience with broad exposure across multiple HR disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong employee relations experience, including investigations, performance management, conflict resolution, and manager coaching.
  • Experience driving organizational change and helping leaders improve team effectiveness and performance.
  • Experience supporting workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, and organizational development initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of employee benefits, leave practices, and other core HR disciplines.
  • Experience leveraging workforce data, reporting, and HR technology tools to support informed decision-making and business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, consulting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic consultation with hands-on execution.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification preferred.

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also receive an annual cash bonus and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

Pay Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $120,000.00 /Yr.

Our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal and commercial clients. ICF combines deep domain expertise with innovative technologies to design, build, modernize, and operate mission-critical systems that improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

ICF is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a large-scale federal Contact Center Operations and Digital Modernization program. The Program Manager will have overall responsibility for the successful management, delivery, and performance of the program, providing leadership for contract execution, operational oversight, modernization initiatives, personnel management, financial performance, and customer satisfaction for a complex enterprise contact center supporting voice, chat, email, SMS, self-service, and digital engagement channels.

The Program Manager serves as the primary day-to-day interface with Government program stakeholders, provides leadership and supervision to program staff, oversees multiple integrated technical and operational workstreams, and ensures effective coordination across functional teams. The successful candidate will possess extensive experience managing large federal technology and operations programs, leading modernization initiatives, and delivering enterprise-scale contact center capabilities using cloud platforms, AI-enabled solutions, CRM technologies, workflow automation, and Agile delivery methodologies.

Job Location

Remote work within the United States is authorized. Must support US Eastern time zone working hours.

*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections. 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for contract performance, including program delivery, staffing, financial management, quality, schedule, risk management, and customer satisfaction.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Government leadership, the COR, and key stakeholders.
  • Lead, mentor, and manage program staff, including performance management, workforce planning, and professional development.
  • Oversee enterprise contact center operations across voice, chat, email, SMS, and digital self-service channels.
  • Monitor and manage SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Direct workforce management, quality assurance, knowledge management, operational reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead integrated workstreams supporting contact center operations, CRM platforms, ServiceNow, telephony, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and analytics.

Basic Qualifications

  • Must reside in the United States, and work must be performed within the United States.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • 12+ years of experience managing large federal IT, contact center, or business transformation programs.
  • 7+ years of experience leading enterprise contact center operations or customer experience programs.
  • 5+ years of experience managing Agile software development or digital modernization initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing geographically dispersed teams supporting federal customers.
  • Experience managing subcontractors and multi-vendor delivery environments.
  • Experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, CRM solutions, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), or similar technologies.
  • Experience leading enterprise contact center modernization initiatives.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled customer service capabilities.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Service Management (ITSM), or CRM implementations.
  • Experience with enterprise contact center platforms such as Genesys, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Cisco, Five9, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Knowledge of customer experience (CX) best practices and human-centered design principles.
  • Experience managing transition-in efforts for large federal contracts.
  • Experience working within FedRAMP cloud environments.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or SAFe certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.
  • Knowledge of Agile software development, IT modernization, and federal program delivery.
  • Strong financial, resource, and schedule management capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to foster collaboration, resolve conflicts, and drive successful program outcomes.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive.
